pages.text: A 3x3x3 block: 22 casings and five special parts.$(br2)If the shell is wrong, the controller names the first wrong block.

pages.name: CFU-7 Shell
pages.text: Rod drive on top, core in the middle, controller and ports on the sides.

pages.title: Layers
pages.text: $(bold)Top:$() 8 casings around the Control Rod Drive$(br2)$(bold)Middle:$() the Core in the center. On the faces: the Controller facing out, 2 Coolant Ports and 1 casing. Corners are casing.$(br2)$(bold)Bottom:$() 9 casings

pages.title: Reactor Casing
pages.text: Iron, copper and obsidian. Makes four.

pages.title: Reactor Core
pages.text: Obsidian, Refined Acheronite and a Thermal Core.

pages.title: Control Rod Drive
pages.text: Iron, redstone, pistons and an iron block.

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Iron, gold, redstone and a glass pane.
